parameters.name: OPERATE
parameters.help: Use MB1 to access the text editor and define equations to overwrite old header words or create new ones.

parameters.name: IENSTRC
parameters.help: You can renumber either the ensemble number or the traces within ensembles.

choices.label: ENSEMBLES
choices.help: Renumber ensembles in the order in which they are input.

choices.label: TRACES
choices.help: Renumber headers of traces within ensembles, renumbering starts at the begining of each ensemble.

parameters.name: CHEADNAM
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the headers menu as the HEADER NAME key for renumbering.

parameters.name: STARTVAL
parameters.help: Value to assign to first trace header encountered, entry for floating point trace headers MUST include a decimal.

parameters.name: INC_VAL
parameters.help: Value by which to increment successive headers, entry for floating point header values MUST include a decimal.

parameters.name: IRESET
parameters.prompt: Reset the Starting value at header change?
parameters.help: Do you want to reset the renumber counter to the Starting value when a different trace header changes value?

parameters.name: CHDRESET
parameters.prompt: SELECT reset renumber trace header word
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the headers menu as the HEADER NAME key for resetting.

parameters.name: ANGLE
parameters.help: Clockwise rotation angle of new coordinate relative to the original axes. (0.0 - 360.0 degrees)

parameters.name: XSHIFT
parameters.help: Value of X coordinate in old system of the new, translated origin.  (0.0 = no shift in X position)

parameters.name: YSHIFT
parameters.help: Value of Y coordinate in the old system of the new, translated origin.  (0.0 = no shift in Y position)

parameters.name: warning
parameters.prompt: ** CHANGE THESE ONLY IF YOU UNDERSTAND THE CONSEQUENCES **

parameters.name: IVALID
parameters.help: Set the global runtime flag for valid database. (i.e. trace numbers are unique and match the database)

parameters.name: IGEOM
parameters.help: Set the global runtime flag for valid geometry. (i.e. geometry in the trace headers matches the database)
